jobs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. The attached image is the USER-SELECTED OrbitCluster logo and the edit target. Preserve the exact blue nebula cloud, fine blue filaments, bright core, blue elliptical orbital ring sweeping from lower-left to upper-right, and the small blue satellite at the upper-right.
